purpose: decompose the already frozen BOP_RODENT primary held-out log-score gain into a species-baseline component and a within-species context component without changing the prospective primary endpoint, model, folds, terminal rule or terminal category

frozen_primary_endpoint.primary_comparator: hierarchically weighted pooled training marginal P(A)

baseline_reconstruction.individual_state_distribution: for each eligible training individual, raw frozen state counts divided by that individual's frozen thinned-event count
baseline_reconstruction.species_training_marginal: within each fold and species, arithmetic mean of the training individuals' individual state distributions; this is exactly the frozen hierarchical weighting conditional on species
baseline_reconstruction.pooled_training_marginal: within each fold, arithmetic mean of the admitted species training marginals; this is exactly the frozen equal-species hierarchical marginal
baseline_reconstruction.required_reconstruction_check: for every held-out individual, the reconstructed pooled marginal mean log score must match the frozen primary_score.mean_marginal_log_score within 1e-10 nats

supports: descriptive quantification of how much of the frozen pooled-baseline gain is attributable to replacing the pooled marginal with a training-fold species marginal
descriptive quantification of the residual gain of the frozen species-aware context model over the corresponding training-fold species marginal
does_not_support: a causal effect of species identity
retuning or replacement of the frozen primary comparator
changing the 27/30 primary result or empirical_state_prediction_mixed terminal category
universal positive within-species context gain for every held-out individual or species
